lead.event: BRI reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth
lead.headline: BBRI reports nine-month profit growth as loans reach Rp1,647.12 trillion
lead.blurb: BRI reported net profit of Rp48.16 trillion through September, while another report put profit attributable to owners at Rp47.69 trillion. Year-on-year growth was reported at 16.8% and 16.94%, respectively. Net interest income rose 6.18% to Rp117.85 trillion, and assets increased 10.1% to Rp2,338 trillion. Gross and net NPL ratios eased to 3.07% and 1.00%.

earnings_guidance.event: BSML reports Q3 freight charter revenue growth and plans fleet strengthening
earnings_guidance.headline: BSML reports 48.39% Q3 freight charter growth and plans to strengthen fleet
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bintang Samudera’s total revenue fell year on year to Rp54.96 billion, while net profit was Rp2.12 billion. It operates 10 owned vessels and four under time charter, and plans to strengthen capacity and service quality to capture growth in commodity distribution and inter-island connectivity.
